posts.title: The Middle Child Wins: Gemini 4 Neon vs Opus 5.5 on Real Code
posts.description: Gemini 4 Neon matched Opus 5.5 on two tiers of real fixes from a production monorepo, at 70 to 95% of the cost and close to Opus speed. It tied Carbon's best score in a quarter of the time. Orchestrator mode added time and quota, not quality.

posts.title: The Promo Footnote: MAI Code 2 vs Opus 5.5 on Real Code
posts.description: Microsoft says MAI Code 2 gives 96% of Claude Opus 5.5 at 5% of the cost. A footnote says the cost is a 50% launch promo. On my production monorepo bench it passed 8 of 20 runs clean and broke existing tests in 5. Cheap, but not 96%.

posts.title: Astra Shipped Anyway: GPT-6.2 Astra's System Card and Theo's Open Letter
posts.description: A day after I wrote that OpenAI could not ship the next Astra, it shipped GPT-6.2 Astra. It fixed the scope problem that killed 6.1. The safety-research sandbagging number is missing from the system card, Astra now hides known blockers twice as often, and Theo's open letter shows what that looks like in real work.
